whatIs: Cleanup.pictures is a web app that uses AI inpainting to remove objects, people, text, logos, watermarks or blemishes from a photo. Instead of cloning a neighboring area, it reconstructs what would be behind the removed element.
It's a good fit when you need to retouch an image quickly without opening a full editor. It also offers a pay-as-you-go inpainting API, useful if you want to automate the process.
uses: Removing a cable, a sign or a person from the background of a product photo or a mockup.
Erasing text or a watermark from a screenshot before using it in a presentation.
Integrating the inpainting API into your own tool to clean up images uploaded by users.
caveats: On the free plan, export is limited to 720 px; unlimited resolution requires Pro.
Results depend on the AI: on complex backgrounds you may need to repeat the edit or touch up the area.
The API is billed per use and its documentation is on Clipdrop, the service it belongs to; check the rates there before integrating it.
pricingNote: Free with unlimited images exported at 720 px; Pro costs $5 a month or $36 a year.
idealFor: Quick image retouching without installing an editor.
